data.revised_prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app direction comp for Glacier Signal, Chinese A-share evaluation workbench, 1536x1024 landscape. This is an operating UI, not sculpture photography. Design as an engineering tensegrity force diagram where score, stop, account risk, and position are visibly constrained by one another. Pale concrete drawing ground, carbon-black struts, red tension cords, ash-gray slack members, engineering leader lines, narrow technical type, precise semantic constraint network. Compact navigation at top; left panel shows stock identity and verdict, with verdict more prominent than diagram: "Glacier Signal", "贵州茅台", "600519.SH", "等待转强", "候选评分 71 / 100". Right panel shows conclusion and position controls. Detailed modules begin below the fold. Keep every essential value legible. Visual tone is restrained, precise, engineering-like, not decorative.
